minecraft:coal.summary: Coal is a mineral fuel and crafting ingredient.
minecraft:coal.obtaining: Mine [[item/minecraft:coal_ore|Coal Ore]] with a pickaxe. Coal veins are common in exposed hills and mountains; caves also provide access to them.
minecraft:coal.uses: Fuel heat stations and make torches. Coal and [[item/minecraft:charcoal|Charcoal]] are interchangeable as fuel in many recipes, but not in every material recipe.

minecraft:charcoal.summary: Charcoal is a renewable fuel produced by processing wood.
minecraft:charcoal.obtaining: Char logs in the Kiln. A tree farm can supply fuel without finding a coal vein.
minecraft:charcoal.uses: Use it for fuel and torches. It is a practical early alternative to [[item/minecraft:coal|Coal]].

minecraft:raw_iron.obtaining: Mine [[item/minecraft:iron_ore|Iron Ore]] or [[item/minecraft:deepslate_iron_ore|Deepslate Iron Ore]] with a stone pickaxe or better. Mountainous terrain and underground veins are useful places to search.
minecraft:raw_iron.uses: Process it in the Kiln to obtain [[item/minecraft:iron_ingot|Iron Ingots]]. Raw metal is not ready for forging equipment.

minecraft:iron_ingot.summary: A versatile metal for equipment, tools, machinery and utility items.
minecraft:iron_ingot.obtaining: Process [[item/minecraft:raw_iron|Raw Iron]] in the Kiln. [[mob/minecraft:iron_golem|Iron Golems]] also drop ingots; [[mob/minecraft:zombie|Zombies]] can rarely drop one after a player kill.
minecraft:iron_ingot.uses: Take it to the [[item/minecraft:anvil|Anvil]] for metal equipment and components. Iron is also useful for repairing suitable equipment and making survival utilities.

minecraft:iron_nugget.obtaining: Break down [[item/minecraft:iron_ingot|Iron Ingots]] through their available assembly recipe, or recover metal through salvage.
minecraft:iron_nugget.uses: Combine nuggets into ingots or use them where a recipe needs small metal fittings. Check the Foundry before destroying valuable gear.

minecraft:raw_copper.obtaining: Mine [[item/minecraft:copper_ore|Copper Ore]] with a stone pickaxe or better. Copper is widespread underground, particularly around dripstone caves.
minecraft:raw_copper.uses: Process it in the Kiln for [[item/minecraft:copper_ingot|Copper Ingots]].

minecraft:copper_ingot.summary: A workable metal used in building parts, mechanisms and alchemy.
minecraft:copper_ingot.obtaining: Process [[item/minecraft:raw_copper|Raw Copper]] in the Kiln. [[mob/minecraft:drowned|Drowned]] can also drop ingots on player kills.
minecraft:copper_ingot.uses: Use Copper in building and utility recipes, or prepare Copper Salt at the [[article/alchemy|Alchemy Stand]]. Shape matching building parts at the [[article/cutting_bench|Cutting Bench]].

minecraft:raw_gold.obtaining: Mine [[item/minecraft:gold_ore|Gold Ore]] with an iron pickaxe or better. Badlands offer extra Gold veins, including above the usual underground deposits.
minecraft:raw_gold.uses: Process it in the Kiln for [[item/minecraft:gold_ingot|Gold Ingots]].

minecraft:gold_ingot.summary: A metal used for equipment, advanced components and special food.
minecraft:gold_ingot.obtaining: Process [[item/minecraft:raw_gold|Raw Gold]] in the Kiln. Other sources include structure treasure and recovered Gold materials.
minecraft:gold_ingot.uses: Gold equipment provides an Energy [[item/minecraft:shield|Shield]]-oriented base. Ingots also serve utility crafts and [[mob/minecraft:piglin|Piglin]] bartering; choose the station appropriate to the finished item.

minecraft:gold_nugget.summary: A small amount of Gold suitable for fine components.
minecraft:gold_nugget.obtaining: Obtain nuggets from [[item/minecraft:nether_gold_ore|Nether Gold Ore]], salvage or breaking down [[item/minecraft:gold_ingot|Gold Ingots]]. [[mob/minecraft:zombified_piglin|Zombified Piglins]] can drop nuggets.
minecraft:gold_nugget.uses: Combine into ingots or use in recipes that need a smaller amount of Gold.

minecraft:diamond.summary: A durable equipment and repair material.
minecraft:diamond.obtaining: Mine [[item/minecraft:diamond_ore|Diamond Ore]] deep underground with an iron pickaxe or better. Deeper cave layers offer more opportunities; structure treasure can also contain Diamonds.
minecraft:diamond.uses: Forge Diamond gear at the [[item/minecraft:anvil|Anvil]], repair compatible gear at the Repair Bench, and make advanced utilities. Diamond bases can roll runes as strong as T8.

minecraft:emerald.summary: A gemstone strongly associated with trading.
minecraft:emerald.obtaining: Trade with [[mob/minecraft:villager|Villagers]] or mine [[item/minecraft:emerald_ore|Emerald Ore]] in mountain biomes with an iron pickaxe or better. Some Illagers drop Emeralds.
minecraft:emerald.uses: Use it for current trades and recipes that specifically request Emeralds. Coins are your separate wallet currency; Emeralds are still physical items.

minecraft:lapis_lazuli.summary: The material spent when applying enchantments.
minecraft:lapis_lazuli.obtaining: Mine [[item/minecraft:lapis_ore|Lapis Lazuli Ore]] with a stone pickaxe or better. The ore is found underground.
minecraft:lapis_lazuli.uses: Use it at the [[item/minecraft:enchanting_table|Enchanting Table]] to add, replace or remove enchantments. The station displays the cost before you confirm.

minecraft:redstone.summary: A dust used for powered mechanisms and control circuits.
minecraft:redstone.obtaining: Mine [[item/minecraft:redstone_ore|Redstone Ore]] with an iron pickaxe or better. Witches also drop Redstone.
minecraft:redstone.uses: Build circuits and automation components. The [[item/minecraft:crafter|Crafter]] uses redstone pulses to produce its programmed recipe.

minecraft:quartz.summary: A Nether mineral used for construction and mechanisms.
minecraft:quartz.obtaining: Mine [[item/minecraft:nether_quartz_ore|Nether Quartz Ore]] with a pickaxe. [[mob/minecraft:piglin|Piglin]] bartering can also supply Quartz.
minecraft:quartz.uses: Use it in mechanism recipes or turn it into building materials. Shape the Quartz building parts at the Cutting Bench.

minecraft:amethyst_shard.summary: A renewable crystal from Amethyst Geodes.
minecraft:amethyst_shard.obtaining: Harvest fully grown Amethyst clusters. [[item/minecraft:budding_amethyst|Budding Amethyst]] grows new clusters and cannot be collected, even with Silk Touch.
minecraft:amethyst_shard.uses: Use shards in optical items and alchemical preparations. Preserve budding blocks if you want a renewable source.

minecraft:netherite_scrap.summary: The direct mining reward from [[item/minecraft:ancient_debris|Ancient Debris]] in this mod.
minecraft:netherite_scrap.obtaining: Break [[item/minecraft:ancient_debris|Ancient Debris]] with a diamond-grade pickaxe or better, without Silk Touch. Silk Touch returns the block; break that block without Silk Touch to obtain Scrap.
minecraft:netherite_scrap.uses: Forge Netherite equipment directly from Scrap at the [[item/minecraft:anvil|Anvil]]. Equipment uses Scrap as its main material rather than upgrading a [[item/minecraft:diamond|Diamond]] item at the [[item/minecraft:smithing_table|Smithing Table]].

minecraft:ancient_debris.summary: A rare Nether ore that yields [[item/minecraft:netherite_scrap|Netherite Scrap]] directly.
minecraft:ancient_debris.obtaining: Search the Nether underground. Silk Touch is required if you want to keep the ore block itself.
minecraft:ancient_debris.uses: Break it with a suitable pickaxe without Silk Touch to get Scrap. It is not a furnace input for Scrap in this mod.

minecraft:netherite_ingot.summary: An alloy distinct from the Scrap used by current Netherite equipment recipes.
minecraft:netherite_ingot.obtaining: Use its available material recipe if you need an ingot; check the station recipe before processing your Scrap.
minecraft:netherite_ingot.uses: Current Netherite equipment is forged directly from Scrap. An ingot cannot replace Scrap in a recipe unless that recipe explicitly accepts it.

minecraft:flint.summary: A sharp material used for ammunition and alchemy.
minecraft:flint.obtaining: Break [[item/minecraft:gravel|Gravel]]. Flint Yield can improve manual harvesting; Silk Touch keeps the [[item/minecraft:gravel|Gravel]] block instead.
minecraft:flint.uses: Make ammunition and tools, or prepare a Flint Suspension for alchemy.

minecraft:gravel.summary: A loose building and gathering block that can yield [[item/minecraft:flint|Flint]].
minecraft:gravel.obtaining: Dig natural Gravel deposits. Gravel appears underground, on shores and in rivers.
minecraft:gravel.uses: Use it for building mixtures or harvest it for [[item/minecraft:flint|Flint]]. Placing and breaking the same material does not provide repeatable discovery XP.

minecraft:sand.summary: A loose building material and the main source of [[item/minecraft:glass|Glass]].
minecraft:sand.obtaining: Dig Sand in deserts, beaches and river margins.
minecraft:sand.uses: Process it into [[item/minecraft:glass|Glass]] in the Kiln, or use it in building mixtures. [[item/minecraft:glass|Glass]] leads to bottles and other glassware.

minecraft:glass.summary: A transparent building material and the basis of bottles.
minecraft:glass.uses: Make bottles, windows and other glass items. Use the Cutting Bench for building variants.

minecraft:glass_bottle.summary: The regular drinking bottle used throughout the potion system.
minecraft:glass_bottle.obtaining: Make bottles from [[item/minecraft:glass|Glass]]. This is the same bottle used by vanilla recipes and the mod's regular potions.
minecraft:glass_bottle.uses: Fill it from a water source or water cauldron. Drinking a potion returns its bottle; thrown potion containers are consumed.

minecraft:clay_ball.summary: A soft mineral material from [[item/minecraft:clay|Clay]] blocks.
minecraft:clay_ball.obtaining: Break [[item/minecraft:clay|Clay]] found in shallow water, rivers and lush caves.
minecraft:clay_ball.uses: Process it into [[item/minecraft:brick|Brick]] or prepare [[item/minecraft:clay|Clay]] Suspension at the Alchemy Stand.

minecraft:brick.uses: Use the Cutting Bench for Brick building parts.

minecraft:slime_ball.summary: An elastic creature material used in mechanisms and alchemy.
minecraft:slime_ball.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:slime|Slimes]]. Swamps and suitable underground slime chunks offer renewable sources.
minecraft:slime_ball.uses: Use it in sticky components or prepare [[mob/minecraft:slime|Slime]] Suspension. Follow the [[mob/minecraft:slime|Slime]] article for spawning conditions.

minecraft:bone.summary: A skeletal material used for farming, animal care and alchemy.
minecraft:bone.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:skeleton|Skeletons]], [[mob/minecraft:stray|Strays]], [[mob/minecraft:bogged|Bogged]] or other skeleton variants. Fossils and structure loot offer other sources.
minecraft:bone.uses: Turn it into [[item/minecraft:bone_meal|Bone Meal]], tame Wolves or prepare Bone Salts at the Alchemy Stand.

minecraft:bone_meal.summary: A farming material that accelerates many plants.
minecraft:bone_meal.obtaining: Process [[item/minecraft:bone|Bones]] through their recipe, or collect Bone Meal from a [[item/minecraft:composter|Composter]].
minecraft:bone_meal.uses: Fertilize suitable plants, grow vegetation and make dye or building recipes. Crop maturity still matters when harvesting for yield bonuses.

minecraft:string.summary: A flexible fibre used in ranged equipment, textiles and utility items.
minecraft:string.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:spider|Spiders]] or [[mob/minecraft:cave_spider|Cave Spiders]], break [[item/minecraft:cobweb|Cobwebs]] with suitable tools, or search structure treasure.
minecraft:string.uses: Use it at the [[item/minecraft:fletching_table|Fletching Table]] for ranged equipment and at the Tailoring Bench for textile crafts.

minecraft:leather.summary: A flexible material for light equipment and bags.
minecraft:leather.obtaining: [[mob/minecraft:cow|Cows]], [[mob/minecraft:horse|Horses]] and several other large animals can supply Leather. Supported leather equipment can also be salvaged at the [[item/minecraft:crafting_table|Crafting Table]].
minecraft:leather.uses: Make light armour, bags and other leather goods at the Tailoring Bench, or use it in utility recipes.

minecraft:rabbit_hide.summary: A small hide useful in leatherworking.
minecraft:rabbit_hide.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:rabbit|Rabbits]]. They inhabit several dry, snowy and meadow environments.
minecraft:rabbit_hide.uses: Convert hides into [[item/minecraft:leather|Leather]] where and use them in recipes that request a small hide.

minecraft:feather.summary: A light material used for stabilizing arrows.
minecraft:feather.obtaining: [[mob/minecraft:chicken|Chickens]] can drop Feathers. [[mob/minecraft:parrot|Parrots]] also drop them, though [[mob/minecraft:chicken|Chickens]] are the practical renewable source.
minecraft:feather.uses: Make arrows and other ranged crafts at the [[item/minecraft:fletching_table|Fletching Table]].

minecraft:rotten_flesh.summary: A common undead drop with alchemical uses.
minecraft:rotten_flesh.uses: Prepare Flesh Suspension at the Alchemy Stand. Eating Rotten Flesh carries its usual Hunger risk.

minecraft:spider_eye.summary: A creature ingredient useful in hostile alchemy.
minecraft:spider_eye.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:spider|Spiders]] or [[mob/minecraft:cave_spider|Cave Spiders]] on a player-attributed kill. Witches can also supply Spider Eyes.
minecraft:spider_eye.uses: Prepare an alchemical component or use it in recipes. It is harmful to eat.

minecraft:gunpowder.summary: An explosive material used in projectiles and potion delivery.
minecraft:gunpowder.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:creeper|Creepers]]; [[mob/minecraft:ghast|Ghasts]] and Witches are other sources. Some structure treasure contains it.
minecraft:gunpowder.uses: Use it for explosive utilities and the appropriate throwable potion preparations. Check the Alchemy Stand for bottle delivery recipes.

minecraft:ender_pearl.summary: A teleportation material obtained from Endermen.
minecraft:ender_pearl.obtaining: Defeat Endermen or obtain Pearls through trades and [[mob/minecraft:piglin|Piglin]] bartering.
minecraft:ender_pearl.uses: Throw it to teleport, accepting the associated damage, or use it in advanced recipes and alchemy.

minecraft:blaze_rod.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:blaze|Blazes]] in Nether Fortresses on player kills.
minecraft:blaze_rod.uses: Use it for advanced recipes or process it into [[item/minecraft:blaze_powder|Blaze Powder]]. It is not a requirement for every Overworld potion in the reworked alchemy system.

minecraft:blaze_powder.obtaining: Prepare it from [[item/minecraft:blaze_rod|Blaze Rods]] through its available recipe.
minecraft:blaze_powder.uses: Use it in advanced crafts and alchemical components. The Alchemy Stand uses explicit recipes rather than vanilla brewing fuel.

minecraft:ghast_tear.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:ghast|Ghasts]] and collect their drops before they fall into lava.
minecraft:ghast_tear.uses: Use it in advanced or restorative recipes. Current potion recipes have Overworld alternatives.

minecraft:magma_cream.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:magma_cube|Magma Cubes]] or use its material recipe.
minecraft:magma_cream.uses: Use it in heat-related crafts and alchemical preparations.

minecraft:prismarine_shard.summary: A marine mineral dropped by monument defenders.
minecraft:prismarine_shard.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:guardian|Guardians]] or [[mob/minecraft:elder_guardian|Elder Guardians]] around Ocean Monuments.
minecraft:prismarine_shard.uses: Make [[item/minecraft:prismarine|Prismarine]] building materials and other ocean-themed items.

minecraft:prismarine_crystals.summary: Crystalline material from ocean defenders and [[item/minecraft:sea_lantern|Sea Lanterns]].
minecraft:prismarine_crystals.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:guardian|Guardians]] or [[mob/minecraft:elder_guardian|Elder Guardians]], or carefully harvest [[item/minecraft:sea_lantern|Sea Lanterns]].
minecraft:prismarine_crystals.uses: Use it for light sources and marine crafts.

minecraft:nautilus_shell.obtaining: Fish it as treasure or defeat a [[mob/minecraft:drowned|Drowned]] that carries a shell. [[mob/minecraft:wandering_trader|Wandering Traders]] may sell it.
minecraft:nautilus_shell.uses: Combine it with a [[item/minecraft:heart_of_the_sea|Heart of the Sea]] through the [[item/minecraft:conduit|Conduit]] recipe.

minecraft:heart_of_the_sea.summary: A rare treasure component for underwater utilities.
minecraft:heart_of_the_sea.obtaining: Find Buried Treasure, often using maps recovered from Shipwrecks and Ocean Ruins.
minecraft:heart_of_the_sea.uses: Use it for a [[item/minecraft:conduit|Conduit]] and any recipes that explicitly request it.

minecraft:phantom_membrane.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:phantom|Phantoms]], which appear around players who have not rested for several nights.
minecraft:phantom_membrane.uses: Use it in compatible [[item/minecraft:elytra|Elytra]] repairs and recipes. Current alchemy also offers Overworld ingredient routes without requiring a membrane for every relevant effect.

minecraft:shulker_shell.uses: Use it to create [[mob/minecraft:shulker|Shulker]] Boxes through their recipe.

minecraft:echo_shard.summary: A rare Deep Dark treasure material.
minecraft:echo_shard.uses: Use it in [[item/minecraft:recovery_compass|Recovery Compass]] and other recipes that explicitly request it.

minecraft:disc_fragment_5.uses: Combine fragments through the recipe to obtain the complete disc.

minecraft:breeze_rod.uses: Use it for [[item/minecraft:wind_charge|Wind Charges]], the [[item/minecraft:mace|Mace]] recipe and other crafts.

minecraft:heavy_core.summary: A rare Trial Chamber treasure component.
minecraft:heavy_core.uses: Use it with a [[item/minecraft:breeze_rod|Breeze Rod]] in the [[item/minecraft:mace|Mace]] recipe.

minecraft:nether_star.uses: Use it for a [[item/minecraft:beacon|Beacon]] or other recipes that specifically request this rare component.

minecraft:turtle_scute.summary: A [[mob/minecraft:turtle|Turtle]] shell material obtained by raising young [[mob/minecraft:turtle|Turtles]].
minecraft:turtle_scute.obtaining: Collect the Scute when a baby [[mob/minecraft:turtle|Turtle]] grows into an adult.
minecraft:turtle_scute.uses: Use it for [[mob/minecraft:turtle|Turtle]] equipment and compatible repairs.

minecraft:armadillo_scute.obtaining: [[item/minecraft:brush|Brush]] an [[mob/minecraft:armadillo|Armadillo]] or collect the Scutes it sheds over time.
minecraft:armadillo_scute.uses: Make and repair [[item/minecraft:wolf_armor|Wolf Armour]] through the equipment systems.

minecraft:wheat.summary: A renewable crop used for food and animal care.
minecraft:wheat.obtaining: Harvest mature Wheat grown from seeds.
minecraft:wheat.uses: Use it in food recipes, breed suitable livestock or prepare Wheat Suspension for alchemy.

minecraft:wheat_seeds.summary: Seeds used to establish a [[item/minecraft:wheat|Wheat]] crop.
minecraft:wheat_seeds.obtaining: Break suitable grass or harvest mature [[item/minecraft:wheat|Wheat]].
minecraft:wheat_seeds.uses: Plant on prepared farmland or feed and breed [[mob/minecraft:chicken|Chickens]].

minecraft:sugar_cane.summary: A waterside plant used for paper, sugar and alchemy.
minecraft:sugar_cane.obtaining: Harvest Cane beside water and leave the lowest section to grow again.
minecraft:sugar_cane.uses: Make [[item/minecraft:paper|Paper]] or [[item/minecraft:sugar|Sugar]], or prepare Cane Suspension.

minecraft:paper.summary: A writing and utility material made from [[item/minecraft:sugar_cane|Sugar Cane]].
minecraft:paper.obtaining: Craft it from [[item/minecraft:sugar_cane|Sugar Cane]] through its available recipe.
minecraft:paper.uses: Make books, map-related items and other written materials.

minecraft:sugar.summary: A processed plant ingredient for food and alchemy.
minecraft:sugar.obtaining: Process [[item/minecraft:sugar_cane|Sugar Cane]]; Witches are another source.
minecraft:sugar.uses: Use it in food recipes and alchemical preparations.

minecraft:melon_slice.summary: A crop ingredient used in food and alchemy.
minecraft:melon_slice.obtaining: Harvest [[item/minecraft:melon|Melon]] blocks, then preserve seeds if you want to start a farm.
minecraft:melon_slice.uses: Eat it, prepare medicinal extracts or use it in food recipes.

minecraft:carrot.summary: A renewable crop and alchemical ingredient.
minecraft:carrot.obtaining: Harvest village crops or grow a Carrot obtained from treasure or a rare [[mob/minecraft:zombie|Zombie]]-family drop.
minecraft:carrot.uses: Eat it, breed suitable animals or prepare an alchemical extract.

minecraft:potato.summary: A renewable crop that becomes useful food when cooked.
minecraft:potato.obtaining: Harvest crops or obtain an initial Potato from village farms, treasure or a rare [[mob/minecraft:zombie|Zombie]]-family drop.
minecraft:potato.uses: Grow more on farmland and cook them at a [[item/minecraft:campfire|Campfire]] or [[item/minecraft:smoker|Smoker]].

minecraft:beetroot.summary: A renewable crop used in food and alchemy.
minecraft:beetroot.obtaining: Grow Beetroot from seeds or find village crops.
minecraft:beetroot.uses: Use it in food, animal care and alchemical extraction.

minecraft:sweet_berries.summary: A renewable forest food and alchemical ingredient.
minecraft:sweet_berries.obtaining: Harvest Sweet Berry bushes in taiga environments.
minecraft:sweet_berries.uses: Eat them, plant bushes, breed Foxes or prepare a restorative extract.

minecraft:glow_berries.summary: A renewable cave fruit with alchemical uses.
minecraft:glow_berries.obtaining: Find Cave [[item/minecraft:vine|Vines]] in lush caves or search suitable treasure.
minecraft:glow_berries.uses: Grow new vines, use the berries as food or prepare glowing alchemical materials.

minecraft:dandelion.summary: A common flower with dye and alchemical uses.
minecraft:dandelion.obtaining: Gather it from grassland vegetation or grow flowers where suitable.
minecraft:dandelion.uses: Make dye or prepare Dandelion Suspension.

minecraft:calcite.summary: A pale mineral associated with geodes and some mountain terrain.
minecraft:calcite.obtaining: Mine Calcite around Amethyst Geodes or in stony peaks.
minecraft:calcite.uses: Use it for building or prepare Calcite Suspension.

minecraft:kelp.summary: An ocean plant useful for food, fuel and alchemy.
minecraft:kelp.obtaining: Harvest Kelp in oceans and replant to establish a farm.
minecraft:kelp.uses: Prepare food and alchemical components; [[item/minecraft:dried_kelp_block|Dried Kelp Blocks]] are a renewable fuel.

minecraft:sea_pickle.summary: A marine organism that also acts as an underwater light source.
minecraft:sea_pickle.obtaining: Find Sea Pickles in warm oceans, especially around coral reefs.
minecraft:sea_pickle.uses: Use them for underwater lighting, dye processing or alchemical extraction.

minecraft:pufferfish.summary: A dangerous fish used as an alchemical ingredient.
minecraft:pufferfish.obtaining: Catch it while fishing or collect it in warm and lukewarm ocean waters.
minecraft:pufferfish.uses: Use it in alchemical preparations. Eating it inflicts harmful effects.

minecraft:cocoa_beans.summary: A jungle crop used for food, dye and alchemy.
minecraft:cocoa_beans.obtaining: Harvest Cocoa pods from [[item/minecraft:jungle_log|Jungle Logs]]; leave or plant new pods for a renewable source.
minecraft:cocoa_beans.uses: Make food and dye, or prepare a Cocoa extract.

minecraft:ink_sac.summary: A dark dye and alchemical ingredient.
minecraft:ink_sac.uses: Use it in dye recipes or alchemical extraction.

minecraft:glow_ink_sac.summary: A luminous writing material and alchemical ingredient.
minecraft:glow_ink_sac.obtaining: Defeat [[mob/minecraft:glow_squid|Glow Squids]] in dark underground waters.
minecraft:glow_ink_sac.uses: Make signs glow, craft display items or prepare glowing alchemical materials.

minecraft:snowball.summary: A cold material for throwing and alchemy.
minecraft:snowball.obtaining: Dig [[item/minecraft:snow|Snow]] layers with a shovel, or collect [[item/minecraft:snow|Snow]] from a [[mob/minecraft:snow_golem|Snow Golem]] trail.
minecraft:snowball.uses: Prepare cold-related alchemical components or use it in recipes.

minecraft:ice.summary: A cold building and crafting material.
minecraft:ice.obtaining: Collect suitable Ice with Silk Touch. Freezing water in cold conditions can provide a renewable source.
minecraft:ice.uses: Use it in construction and cold-related recipes.

minecraft:honeycomb.summary: A bee product useful for waxed construction and alchemy.
minecraft:honeycomb.obtaining: Use [[item/minecraft:shears|Shears]] on a full [[item/minecraft:beehive|Beehive]] or [[item/minecraft:bee_nest|Bee Nest]]. Calm the bees with smoke where appropriate.
minecraft:honeycomb.uses: Wax suitable blocks, make candles and prepare alchemical components.

minecraft:honey_bottle.summary: A bottled bee product with food and alchemical uses.
minecraft:honey_bottle.obtaining: Use a [[item/minecraft:glass_bottle|Glass Bottle]] on a full hive or nest, taking precautions against angry bees.
minecraft:honey_bottle.uses: Drink it, process it in recipes or prepare alchemical components.

minecraft:stick.summary: A basic wooden component used throughout crafting.
minecraft:stick.obtaining: Make it from Planks or [[item/minecraft:bamboo|Bamboo]]; leaves and some other sources can also provide Sticks.
minecraft:stick.uses: Use it in tools, weapons, torches and utility recipes. Keep a supply when establishing your first stations.

minecraft:flint_and_steel.uses: [[item/minecraft:light|Light]] [[item/minecraft:campfire|Campfires]], ignite suitable blocks and activate a Nether Portal when dimension travel is available.

minecraft:bundle.summary: The early six-slot bag in this mod.
minecraft:bundle.obtaining: Craft it through the Tailoring Bench's bag recipe.
minecraft:bundle.uses: Equip it in one of the five bag slots to unlock six dedicated storage slots. The Bundle itself cannot contain items; empty its corresponding storage before removing it. Bags remain equipped on death, while bag-inventory contents are dropped.

minecraft:bookshelf.summary: A storage-themed building block used around study areas.
minecraft:bookshelf.obtaining: Use its building recipe at the appropriate station.
minecraft:bookshelf.uses: Decorate a room or use it where a recipe or station specifically asks for Bookshelves. Enchanting uses chosen enchantments and explicit material costs rather than vanilla random rolls.

minecraft:book.summary: A writing material used in study and utility recipes.
minecraft:book.obtaining: Use its available recipe or obtain Books from structure loot.
minecraft:book.uses: Use it in recipes. [[item/minecraft:enchanted_book|Enchanted Books]] are not a substitute for paying the [[item/minecraft:enchanting_table|Enchanting Table]]'s displayed costs.

minecraft:enchanted_book.obtaining: Find it in treasure and trades.
minecraft:enchanted_book.uses: Inspect its enchantments for their effects. [[item/minecraft:book|Books]] do not currently teach or directly apply enchantments; use the [[item/minecraft:enchanting_table|Enchanting Table]] to choose a compatible effect and pay its displayed cost.

minecraft:name_tag.summary: A consumable used to name an animal or other creature.
minecraft:name_tag.obtaining: Find one in treasure, fishing rewards or trades.
minecraft:name_tag.uses: Use it to open the naming panel. A newly tamed animal receives a free naming prompt only at that moment; closing the prompt forfeits that free name.

minecraft:saddle.obtaining: Craft it at the Tailoring Bench or obtain it from treasure and trades.
minecraft:saddle.uses: Equip it on an appropriate mount. Ownership and taming rules depend on the animal; see Mounts before trying to claim an unfamiliar species.

minecraft:chest.summary: A basic storage block that can also serve as mount cargo.
minecraft:chest.uses: Store items through the container interface or equip it as a Mount Attachment on a compatible owned mount.

cranks-dungeons:armourers_scrap.summary: A consumable material for improving armour quality.
cranks-dungeons:armourers_scrap.obtaining: Earn it through the mod's creature and treasure loot pools.
cranks-dungeons:armourers_scrap.uses: Use it at the Upgrade Bench to improve compatible armour. The station shows the resulting quality and material cost before confirmation.

cranks-dungeons:blacksmiths_whetstone.summary: A consumable material for improving weapon quality.
cranks-dungeons:blacksmiths_whetstone.obtaining: Earn it through the mod's creature and treasure loot pools.
cranks-dungeons:blacksmiths_whetstone.uses: Use it at the Upgrade Bench to improve compatible weapons. Quality improves the relevant base properties before their runes and other bonuses are evaluated.

cranks-dungeons:deepslate_sigil.summary: An equipment-upgrade material used to expand enchantment capacity.
cranks-dungeons:deepslate_sigil.obtaining: Find it among the mod's creature and treasure rewards.
cranks-dungeons:deepslate_sigil.uses: Use it at the Upgrade Bench to add an available enchantment slot. The equipment's limits and current upgrade cost are shown at the bench.

minecraft:totem_of_undying.summary: A consumable protection against a qualifying lethal hit.
minecraft:totem_of_undying.uses: Hold it in either hand when the fatal hit arrives. It is consumed when it saves you; keeping it elsewhere in the inventory does not activate it.

minecraft:glowstone_dust.summary: A luminous material with both Nether and Overworld sources.
minecraft:glowstone_dust.uses: Make [[item/minecraft:glowstone|Glowstone]] and utilities. [[item/minecraft:potion|Potion]] strength now comes from Lesser or regular brewing, rather than an old vanilla [[item/minecraft:glowstone|Glowstone]] upgrade chain.

minecraft:nether_wart.summary: A crop associated with Nether structures.
minecraft:nether_wart.obtaining: Find it around suitable Nether structures and grow it on [[item/minecraft:soul_sand|Soul Sand]].
minecraft:nether_wart.uses: Use it in recipes. The Alchemy Stand does not require an Awkward [[item/minecraft:potion|Potion]] sequence for every potion.

minecraft:ender_eye.summary: A utility for finding and activating the route to the End.
minecraft:ender_eye.uses: Throw it to locate a Stronghold and place it in empty [[item/minecraft:end_portal_frame|End Portal Frames]]. It is distinct from the teleporting [[item/minecraft:ender_pearl|Ender Pearl]].

minecraft:end_crystal.summary: An explosive crystal used in the Dragon respawn ritual.
minecraft:end_crystal.uses: Place four at the midpoints around the [[item/minecraft:bedrock|Bedrock]] exit portal in the End to summon another Dragon. Crystals are explosive, not harmless decoration.

minecraft:dragon_breath.summary: A bottled material collected during a Dragon encounter.
minecraft:dragon_breath.obtaining: Use [[item/minecraft:glass_bottle|Glass Bottles]] on the Dragon's lingering breath cloud.
minecraft:dragon_breath.uses: Use it in recipes. Current Overworld alchemy does not require Dragon Breath for every lingering potion.

minecraft:compass.obtaining: Craft it or find it in treasure.
minecraft:compass.uses: An ordinary Compass points toward world spawn in its applicable dimension. A [[item/minecraft:lodestone|Lodestone]]-bound Compass instead follows its bound [[item/minecraft:lodestone|Lodestone]].

minecraft:recovery_compass.summary: A utility for locating your last death.
minecraft:recovery_compass.obtaining: Use its available recipe with a [[item/minecraft:compass|Compass]] and [[item/minecraft:echo_shard|Echo Shards]].
minecraft:recovery_compass.uses: Follow it in the dimension of your last death. It does not recover items automatically.

minecraft:clock.uses: Read the Overworld day/night cycle without seeing the sky. It behaves unreliably in dimensions without that cycle.

minecraft:shears.summary: A tool for collecting certain resources without ordinary drops.
minecraft:shears.uses: Shear [[mob/minecraft:sheep|Sheep]], collect suitable foliage and use other shearable-creature interactions. Some rewards are renewable without killing the animal.

minecraft:brush.uses: Brush [[item/minecraft:suspicious_sand|Suspicious Sand]] or [[item/minecraft:gravel|Gravel]] to uncover items, or brush [[mob/minecraft:armadillo|Armadillos]] to collect Scutes.

minecraft:lead.summary: A restraint for moving suitable animals.
minecraft:lead.obtaining: Craft it or obtain it from sources.
minecraft:lead.uses: Lead a compatible creature or tether it to a Fence. Mount ownership and whistle commands are separate from attaching a Lead.

minecraft:fishing_rod.uses: Cast into suitable water and retrieve a bite at the right moment for fish and occasional treasure. Repeat catches do not repeat a first-discovery World XP reward.

minecraft:carrot_on_a_stick.uses: Hold it while riding a saddled [[mob/minecraft:pig|Pig]] to control movement. Naming and ownership use the mount system.

minecraft:warped_fungus_on_a_stick.uses: Hold it while riding a saddled [[mob/minecraft:strider|Strider]]. Keeping the [[mob/minecraft:strider|Strider]] warm also matters for its speed.

minecraft:bucket.summary: A reusable container for fluids and certain creatures.
minecraft:bucket.uses: Collect fluids, Milk livestock or move a living fish, [[mob/minecraft:axolotl|Axolotl]] or [[mob/minecraft:tadpole|Tadpole]] in water rather than just collecting its dropped item.

minecraft:water_bucket.obtaining: Fill an empty [[item/minecraft:bucket|Bucket]] from a water source.
minecraft:water_bucket.uses: Place water for travel, farming and construction. The [[item/minecraft:bucket|Bucket]] remains after placement.

minecraft:lava_bucket.obtaining: Fill an empty [[item/minecraft:bucket|Bucket]] from a lava source.
minecraft:lava_bucket.uses: Place lava or use it as suitable station fuel. The placed fluid is a serious environmental hazard.

minecraft:milk_bucket.summary: A drink that clears status effects.
minecraft:milk_bucket.obtaining: Use an empty [[item/minecraft:bucket|Bucket]] on a [[mob/minecraft:cow|Cow]] or [[mob/minecraft:mooshroom|Mooshroom]].
minecraft:milk_bucket.uses: Drink it to clear effects, remembering that beneficial buffs can be removed too.

minecraft:bowl.uses: Prepare soups and stews, or collect stew from a suitable [[mob/minecraft:mooshroom|Mooshroom]]. Bowl-based foods return the container when eaten.

minecraft:apple.obtaining: Harvest suitable tree leaves or obtain Apples through treasure and trades.
minecraft:apple.uses: Eat it or prepare [[item/minecraft:golden_apple|Golden Apple]] recipes. Sapling Yield can help eligible manually harvested Apple drops.

minecraft:golden_apple.summary: A restorative food with temporary beneficial effects.
minecraft:golden_apple.obtaining: Craft it or find it in suitable treasure.
minecraft:golden_apple.uses: Eat it for its listed effects, or use it with Weakness to cure a [[mob/minecraft:zombie_villager|Zombie Villager]]. Current effect tooltips show the mod's bonuses.

minecraft:enchanted_golden_apple.obtaining: Find it in suitable generated treasure.
minecraft:enchanted_golden_apple.uses: Use its listed effects as a scarce emergency resource rather than relying on a renewable crop supply.

minecraft:golden_carrot.summary: A prepared food and alchemical ingredient.
minecraft:golden_carrot.obtaining: Craft it or obtain it from trades.
minecraft:golden_carrot.uses: Eat it or prepare Golden Carrot Extract at the Alchemy Stand.

minecraft:rabbit_foot.summary: A rare [[mob/minecraft:rabbit|Rabbit]] material used in alchemy.
minecraft:rabbit_foot.uses: Prepare [[mob/minecraft:rabbit|Rabbit]] Foot Extract for experiments and mixtures.

minecraft:fermented_spider_eye.uses: Prepare Fermented Eye Extract at the Alchemy Stand.

minecraft:brown_mushroom.summary: A fungus used for food and alchemy.
minecraft:brown_mushroom.obtaining: Gather it in suitable dark or mushroom-rich environments.
minecraft:brown_mushroom.uses: Prepare food or Mushroom Extract at the Alchemy Stand.

minecraft:red_mushroom.summary: A fungus used for food and decoration.
minecraft:red_mushroom.obtaining: Gather it in suitable dark or mushroom-rich environments.
minecraft:red_mushroom.uses: Use it in recipes. Check extraction inputs before treating it as a substitute for [[item/minecraft:brown_mushroom|Brown Mushroom]].

minecraft:obsidian.summary: A hard construction and utility material.
minecraft:obsidian.obtaining: Create it where water contacts suitable lava and mine it with a diamond-grade pickaxe or better.
minecraft:obsidian.uses: Build a Nether Portal frame or make advanced stations and utilities.

minecraft:crying_obsidian.obtaining: Find it around Ruined Portals, in suitable treasure or through [[mob/minecraft:piglin|Piglin]] bartering.
minecraft:crying_obsidian.uses: Use it for utilities and decoration. It does not substitute for ordinary [[item/minecraft:obsidian|Obsidian]] in a portal frame.

minecraft:soul_sand.summary: A terrain block with farming, water-column and ritual uses.
minecraft:soul_sand.obtaining: Gather it in suitable Nether locations.
minecraft:soul_sand.uses: Grow [[item/minecraft:nether_wart|Nether Wart]], form upward water bubble columns or build the [[mob/minecraft:wither|Wither]] ritual.

minecraft:soul_soil.summary: A Nether terrain and ritual material.
minecraft:soul_soil.obtaining: Gather it in [[item/minecraft:soul_sand|Soul Sand]] Valley terrain.
minecraft:soul_soil.uses: Use it for Soul Fire-related crafts and the [[mob/minecraft:wither|Wither]] ritual. It does not replace [[item/minecraft:soul_sand|Soul Sand]] in every farming or water-column use.

minecraft:wind_charge.obtaining: Prepare it from [[mob/minecraft:breeze|Breeze]] materials through its recipe.
minecraft:wind_charge.uses: Use the burst for movement or knockback, planning the landing as well as the launch.

minecraft:firework_rocket.summary: A consumable firework with travel and display uses.
minecraft:firework_rocket.uses: Use appropriate rockets for [[item/minecraft:elytra|Elytra]] travel or displays. Payload and flight properties depend on the rocket you make.

minecraft:goat_horn.summary: A sound-producing item from a [[mob/minecraft:goat|Goat]] interaction.
minecraft:goat_horn.obtaining: Let a suitable [[mob/minecraft:goat|Goat]] ram an appropriate solid block so a Horn breaks off.
minecraft:goat_horn.uses: Play its Horn sound. Killing a [[mob/minecraft:goat|Goat]] is not the normal way to obtain one.

minecraft:sniffer_egg.summary: An egg that hatches into a [[mob/minecraft:sniffer|Sniffer]].
minecraft:sniffer_egg.obtaining: Recover it through suitable warm Ocean Ruin archaeology.
minecraft:sniffer_egg.uses: Place it to hatch and raise the [[mob/minecraft:sniffer|Sniffer]] for its digging finds. Moss is a useful hatching surface.

minecraft:torchflower_seeds.obtaining: Let a [[mob/minecraft:sniffer|Sniffer]] dig in suitable ground.
minecraft:torchflower_seeds.uses: Grow [[item/minecraft:torchflower|Torchflowers]] for farming and decorative uses.

minecraft:pitcher_pod.summary: A planting item found by a [[mob/minecraft:sniffer|Sniffer]].
minecraft:pitcher_pod.obtaining: Let a [[mob/minecraft:sniffer|Sniffer]] dig in suitable ground.

minecraft:torch.obtaining: Use Hand Crafting with its required wooden component and fuel.
minecraft:torch.uses: [[item/minecraft:light|Light]] paths and work areas for visibility and to reduce ordinary darkness-based monster spawning.

minecraft:lantern.summary: A standing or hanging light source.
minecraft:lantern.uses: [[item/minecraft:light|Light]] and decorate work areas, following its hanging or standing placement rules.

minecraft:stone.obtaining: Mine it with Silk Touch or process [[item/minecraft:cobblestone|Cobblestone]] in the Kiln.
minecraft:stone.uses: Use it directly or shape Stone building parts at the Cutting Bench.

minecraft:cobblestone.obtaining: Mine [[item/minecraft:stone|Stone]] with a suitable pickaxe without Silk Touch.
minecraft:cobblestone.uses: Make early gear and stations, process it into [[item/minecraft:stone|Stone]] or shape building parts.

minecraft:deepslate.uses: Use it for construction and Cutting Bench conversions. Ordinary mining instead produces [[item/minecraft:cobbled_deepslate|Cobbled Deepslate]].

minecraft:cobbled_deepslate.obtaining: Mine [[item/minecraft:deepslate|Deepslate]] with a suitable pickaxe without Silk Touch.
minecraft:cobbled_deepslate.uses: Shape its building family at the Cutting Bench or process it through recipes.
